
REMOVE-PERSONA
Remove a persona from foundation.json or foundation.json.draft by exact name match (case-sensitive). Used to correct mistakes during foundation discovery or remove obsolete personas.

WHEN TO USE
  Use during foundation discovery to correct mistakes, or when updating an existing foundation to remove personas that are no longer relevant to the system.

PREREQUISITES
  • foundation.json or foundation.json.draft must exist
  • Persona must exist with exact name match

USAGE
  fspec remove-persona "<name>"

ARGUMENTS
  <name> (required)
    Exact name of the persona to remove (case-sensitive). Must match existing persona name exactly.

OPTIONS
  No options available

TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  List current personas: Check foundation.json or foundation.json.draft,Remove persona: fspec remove-persona "exact name",Verify removal: Check updated foundation file

EXAMPLES
  1. Remove persona by exact name
  $ fspec remove-persona "Developer"
  ✓ Removed persona "Developer" from foundation.json.draft

  2. Remove persona from finalized foundation
  $ fspec remove-persona "End User"
  ✓ Removed persona "End User" from foundation.json

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ foundation.json not found
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ Persona "Name" not found
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ No personas exist in foundation
    Fix: undefined

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec fspec add-persona - Add persona to foundation
  fspec fspec discover-foundation - Foundation discovery process
  fspec fspec remove-capability - Remove capability from foundation
  fspec fspec update-foundation - Update foundation fields

NOTES
  • Draft file (foundation.json.draft) takes precedence over foundation.json
  • Name matching is case-sensitive and must be exact
  • Removal is permanent - no undo functionality
  • Error message shows available personas if name not found
